android.desc:
⌚NOW WITH TILE! Directly access your favorites ⏰ on the newly added Tile.

Unlock the power of precise time management with MultiTimerPro for Wear OS – the ultimate timer companion for your smartwatch! Tired of being limited to a single timer on your device? Say goodbye to those constraints and welcome a new era of multitasking efficiency.

MultiTimerPro empowers you to set and manage multiple timers simultaneously on your smartwatch, a feature notably absent in the stock timer app. Whether you're juggling cooking times, workout intervals, or productivity sprints, this app has got you covered.

Key Features:
🕒 Multi-Timer Functionality: Run multiple timers concurrently, allowing you to keep track of various activities without missing a beat.
🚀 Intuitive Interface: Effortlessly create, edit, and manage timers with a user-friendly interface designed for seamless navigation.
⏰ Customization Options: Tailor each timer to your specific needs with customizable names, durations, icons and colors.
🔊 Sound notifications: Now you can also add sound to your timers, so you never miss them again!

Upgrade your timekeeping experience with MultiTimerPro and redefine how you manage your day. Download now and take control of your time like never before!

quotes.text: After grabbing a Pixel Watch I realized these watches still have the same (stupid) limitation as the previous Galaxy Watches with Tizen: You cannot start multiple timers simultaneously... So I developed an App which does exactly that, it allows you to start multiple timers concurrently! You can save predefined timers with icons, colors and names and thus gives you quick access to your powernap timer while running the tea timer in parallel!
